name: SAER
full_name: SAER Surgeon Augmented Endovascular Robotic system
group: Univ. of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / Univ. at Buffalo (Kesavadas, Siddiqui, Snyder)
versions: 2018 TBME (sankaran2018_design); 2020 IJMRCAS force calibration of the same robot's current-based proximal force estimate by bilevel optimisation (sankaran2020_force, full)
target_anatomy: branching vascular phantoms (one mimics bovine aortic arch)
devices_driven: conventional guidewire (same type on leader and follower)
rotation_detail: motor rotating the roller box about the tool axis (slip ring)
force_sensing: none; reaction force estimated from motor current, calibrated by bilevel optimisation, checked against a load cell
haptics_leader: sensing unit with encoder-read rollers on a real tool; vibratory/audio alert above 1.5 N (no force reflection)
validation_detail: simple and complex branching phantoms; count of runs N.R.; 2020: load-cell bench with a short phantom section and guidewire navigation in a simple branching phantom with a haptic alert at the block (sankaran2020 Figs. 2, 9)
key_numbers: stop/haptic threshold 1.5 N; force estimate validated at 30 and 50 rpm (curves, no error number); 2020: guidewire feed 15.7 mm/s at 30 rpm; bias force 0.6716 N at 30 rpm; unbiased estimate vs load cell RMS error 0.22 N (30 rpm) and 0.23 N (50 rpm) (sankaran2020 Results, Fig. 8)
sim_model: dynamic model of the drive only (no vessel simulator)
